categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of new electronic materials, focusing mainly on photovoltaic conductive silver paste used in solar cells. It also develops electronic pastes, conductive adhesives, and semiconductor materials, serving the solar photovoltaic, display/lighting, and semiconductor sectors. Additionally, it has expanded into upstream raw materials like electronic-grade silver powder and glass powder production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in photovoltaic conductive silver paste, including high-efficiency crystalline silicon solar cell main and fine grid silver paste, TOPCon high-efficiency cell silver paste, ultra-low resistivity low-temperature silver paste, and LECO laser sintering technology. It uses proprietary formulations and manufacturing processes such as high shear ultra-fine dispersion, automatic high-viscosity paste filling, and vacuum filtration. The company also integrates digital R&D management systems and collaborates with domestic and international research institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading solar cell manufacturers including Tongwei Solar, Jinko Solar, Trina Solar, Risen Energy, JA Solar, and others. The company serves mainly the photovoltaic industry, supplying conductive silver paste critical for solar cell electrodes. It also extends products to electronic components, 5G filters, energy storage, consumer electronics, and automotive electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and production facilities in Thailand and Japan, including a global R&D center in Japan and a silver paste production plant in Thailand. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with increasing overseas market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned upstream in the photovoltaic industry supply chain as a key supplier of conductive silver paste and related electronic materials. It has expanded upstream by acquiring and developing electronic-grade silver powder production capabilities, enhancing raw material supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment focusing on next-generation photovoltaic technologies such as N-type TOPCon, HJT, and XBC cells. The company emphasizes innovation in ultra-narrow line width printing, low-temperature sintering, alloy pastes, and low-cost conductive materials. It also aims to expand into non-photovoltaic electronic pastes and adhesives for emerging applications like 5G, energy storage, and flexible electronics, while building a global powder material R&D and production center.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of photovoltaic conductive silver paste and related electronic materials to solar cell manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company also earns income from investments and financial products. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales to major customers and distributor networks for smaller clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the photovoltaic conductive silver paste market, holding the largest global market share in photovoltaic silver paste with over 2,000 tons annual shipment. It has broken foreign monopolies in this sector and competes with other major Chinese and international suppliers. Its strong R&D, product quality, and customer service provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 10.29 billion, a 58.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 442 million, up 13%. Total assets grew nearly 29% to RMB 7.5 billion. The company has shown rapid growth driven by expanding production capacity and market demand, with significant R&D investment accounting for over 6% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, stable, and cost-effective photovoltaic conductive silver paste products that support advanced solar cell technologies and improve power conversion efficiency. Its unique value lies in proprietary formulations, rapid product iteration aligned with evolving photovoltaic technologies, and comprehensive customer support including on-site technical assistance. Vertical integration into raw material production enhances supply stability and cost competitiveness.
